$comment: The CI contract of this app's matrix leg (scripts/affected.mjs, .gitea/actions/app-gates, ADR 0014 §6). Commands run from the repo root, one per line of a step; the Rust gates (fmt, clippy, nextest, doc tests, deny) run in 'cargo'. Its UI is ui/projects/shell-demo, tested by the ui and e2e jobs.
